title: MATH 3042 Statistics · Unit 2
subtitle: Visualizing data, and Lab 2 (grouped statistics in R), preparing for Quiz 2
description: Unit 2, descriptive statistics by picture: frequency tables, pie and bar charts, stem-and-leaf plots, the histogram recipe (classes from √n), cumulative relative frequencies and ogives, scatter plots. Plus Lab 2: favstats and model formulas, grouped percentiles and percent ranks, Z-scores on real data, and the four pencil problems. Live chart builders, the instructor's own worked numbers, a mock quiz and a formula sheet.
intro:
:::quiz Quiz 2 scope
Lecture Unit 02 (visualizing data) and Lab 2. Lab 2 says its **pencil problems** prepare you for the theory part of the quiz: building a frequency distribution, reading percentiles from the empirical rule, range/IQR/fences, and reading an ogive. Expect the Unit 1 tools (quartiles, fences, Sk, empirical rule, Chebyshev) to reappear inside Unit 2 questions. Bring a scientific calculator.
:::
